findings.description:
Reentrancy in Marketplace.placeBid(uint256,uint256) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#623-699):
	External calls:
	- usdc.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amount) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#663-667)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- auction.highestBid = amount (contracts/Marketplace.sol#683)
	Marketplace.auctions (contracts/Marketplace.sol#185) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- Marketplace.auctionExists(uint256) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#897-905)
	- Marketplace.auctions (contracts/Marketplace.sol#185)
	- Marketplace.isAuctionActive(uint256) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#879-892)
	- auction.highestBidder = msg.sender (contracts/Marketplace.sol#684)
	Marketplace.auctions (contracts/Marketplace.sol#185) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- Marketplace.auctionExists(uint256) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#897-905)
	- Marketplace.auctions (contracts/Marketplace.sol#185)
	- Marketplace.isAuctionActive(uint256) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#879-892)
RoyaltySplitter._validateRecipients(address,IRoyaltySplitter.RoyaltyRecipient[]).totalShares (contracts/RoyaltySplitter.sol#280) is a local variable never initialized
RoyaltySplitter.distributeRoyalty(address,IRoyaltySplitter.RoyaltyRecipient[],uint256).recipientsPaid (contracts/RoyaltySplitter.sol#382) is a local variable never initialized
Marketplace.listFixedPrice(uint256,uint256,IRoyaltySplitter.RoyaltyRecipient[]).totalShares (contracts/Marketplace.sol#354) is a local variable never initialized
Marketplace.createAuction(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,IRoyaltySplitter.RoyaltyRecipient[]).totalShares (contracts/Marketplace.sol#560) is a local variable never initialized

Reentrancy in Marketplace.endAuction(uint256) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#727-797):
	External calls:
	- usdc.safeTransfer(address(royaltySplitter),auction.highestBid) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#769-772)
	- royaltySplitter.distributeRoyalty(auction.seller,auctionRecipients[auctionId],auction.highestBid) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#778-782)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- purchaseCount[auction.tokenId][auction.highestBidder] += 1 (contracts/Marketplace.sol#790)

Reentrancy in Marketplace.placeBid(uint256,uint256) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#623-699):
	External calls:
	- usdc.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amount) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#663-667)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- auctionBids[auctionId].push(Bid({amount:amount,bidder:msg.sender,timestamp:uint40(block.timestamp)})) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#686-692)
	- pendingRefunds[auction.highestBidder] += auction.highestBid (contracts/Marketplace.sol#675-676)

Reentrancy in Marketplace._buyAsset(uint256,address) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#458-511):
	External calls:
	- usdc.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender,address(royaltySplitter),price) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#489-493)
	- royaltySplitter.distributeRoyalty(seller,listingRecipients[listingId],price) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#495-499)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- purchaseCount[tokenId][buyer] += 1 (contracts/Marketplace.sol#503)

Marketplace.listingExists(uint256) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#864-872) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- listings[listingId].tokenId != 0 (contracts/Marketplace.sol#871)

Marketplace.listFixedPrice(uint256,uint256,IRoyaltySplitter.RoyaltyRecipient[]) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#321-395) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- existingListing != 0 && listings[existingListing].active (contracts/Marketplace.sol#340)

Marketplace.placeBid(uint256,uint256) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#623-699) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < auction.startTime (contracts/Marketplace.sol#639)
	- block.timestamp >= auction.endTime (contracts/Marketplace.sol#642)

Marketplace.endAuction(uint256) (contracts/Marketplace.sol#727-797) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < auction.endTime (contracts/Marketplace.sol#742)
